summary: glm53-tp2 prefill is 2-6% faster: prefill all-reduces go through the b12x PCIe DMA path
compatibility: Only the glm53-tp2 preset changes; VLLM_PCIE_DMA_MIN_BYTES set by the operator still wins.
details: The preset sets VLLM_PCIE_DMA_MIN_BYTES=6MB (the launcher otherwise turns the DMA all-reduce off for GLM with DCP above 1). On two RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q prefill at 8K/32K tokens measured 7,656/7,992 instead of 7,490/7,728 tok/s with a16 prefill activations and 9,952/10,334 instead of 9,528/9,784 with a4, decode unchanged.
